description: planGitHubToken: the node holding a goal's plan claim reads the project's GitHub tokens for its own fetch — one row per enrolled repo, each minted from that repo's own GitHub App installation and scoped to it, the way issueItemRepoToken is scoped to an item's one repo. researchGitHubToken(directionId) answers a direction's research session the same shape. The runsheet goal a-plan-clones-on-the-platforms-token serves this same shape at /contracts/planGitHubToken.json — the platform side of the contract.
